browser: Chrome DevTools MCP (headless Chrome) on macOS

assets.title: Library · desktop
assets.steps: Full library; Library; light. Fresh reload restores seven fixtures.

assets.title: Reading · desktop
assets.steps: Open “A quieter internet…” from the library. Summary selected.

assets.title: Source · desktop
assets.steps: On the lead reading, select Source. Captured at top; source continues below.

assets.title: Connection trail
assets.steps: Follow “Libraries are gardens…” from the lead reading. The destination shows its origin and return action.

assets.title: Reading · dark
assets.steps: Return to lead reading, Summary, Dark theme.

assets.title: Search and tag
assets.steps: Library; search gardens; select Knowledge. Open and return preserves these filters.

assets.title: Save URL
assets.steps: Save reading; URL tab; default sample URL and Ready preview result.

assets.title: Pending
assets.steps: Save URL with Ready preview result. Dynamic sample capture-1 is pending.

assets.title: Ready
assets.steps: From capture-1 pending, click Check status. No real job runs.

assets.title: Source failure
assets.steps: Select Failed capture. Recovery actions and collapsed diagnostics shown.

assets.title: Provider · missing key
assets.steps: Open Provider with its initial Missing key state. Scenario selector still says Failed capture; it does not control provider state.

assets.title: Library · phone
assets.steps: Fresh reload at library; 390 × 658 viewport, Desktop layout toggle, light.

assets.title: Reading · phone
assets.steps: Open lead reading, Summary. Page continues below.

assets.title: Connections · phone
assets.steps: Click Connections & tensions; allow smooth scroll to settle. Captured scrolled to the panel, with return action.

assets.title: Reading · phone dark
assets.steps: Return to the reading and select Dark theme.

assets.title: Markdown · phone
assets.steps: Light theme; Save reading; Markdown tab with authored default text.

assets.title: Provider removed · phone
assets.steps: Provider; Preview setup state → Removed key. Top of page, including retained-library explanation.

assets.title: Long title · phone
assets.steps: Sample scenario → Long title. Title wraps without clipping.

assets.title: Failure · phone dark
assets.steps: Sample scenario → Failed capture; Dark theme. Recovery controls continue below viewport.

assets.title: Unavailable source
assets.steps: 1440 × 930 viewport; Light theme; Sample scenario → Unavailable source.

assets.title: Removed target
assets.steps: Sample scenario → Deleted connection, then open “Notes on the attention economy.” The selector alone opens its originating reading.

assets.title: Sparse reading
assets.steps: Sample scenario → Sparse archive, then open the only reading. Novelty and relationships state insufficient history.
